title: Make a data table
summary: R: Make a data table. Read the title column.
introduction: A data frame stores columns of the same row count. Each column has a name.
learningObjectives: Make a data table with R

blocks.text: Install R. Save an example as lesson.R and run Rscript lesson.R, or paste it into the R console.

blocks.title: Make a data table
blocks.code:
books <- data.frame(title = c("Moon", "Sun"), pages = c(24, 30))
cat(books$pages, "\n")

blocks.text: The dollar operator selects the pages column with values 24 and 30.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Keep all columns the same length.
